{{Top|leg}}
A '''gram''' was a unit of mass. [[Spice/Legends|Spice]], an often illegal narcotic, was measured per dose, which equaled about ten grams.

On the spice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sevarcos II]], [[Andris/Legends|andris]] spice, while legal, typically sold at an expensive rate of one [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] per ten-gram dose.
